name: vega: a layered chart keeps one data source
description: Vega-Lite accepts `data` inside every layer, which is the escape the tool refuses. A scatter with a fitted line is the natural two-layer request; both layers have to read the one dataset the tool points at, so a run that puts rows in a layer is refused and has to recover.
inputs: Plot Glucose against BMI from the dataset in this history as a scatter plot with a fitted trend line over it.
